justification: In `jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/JimfsFileStore.java` the class is a 265-line FileStore façade with a small constructor plus mostly one-line delegating methods; it does not contain large independent algorithms or a high method count. The file’s own Javadoc says the real work is split into `FileTree` (lookup), `FileFactory` (creation/copying), and `AttributeService` (attributes), and the inspected collaborator files confirm that decomposition: `FileFactory.java`, `AttributeService.java`, and `FileTree.java` each own a focused responsibility. That structure argues against insufficient modularization in this class.
